releaseNotes:
Notes v1.8.72 (Build 244):
- Fixed Watch Together sync button and player playback unstarted state deadlock
- Fixed Android App Settings app name and icon synchronization when switching disguise app to Notes
- Accurate real-time online/offline presence status with zero-delay offline detection
- Smooth 120 FPS chat screen scrolling without layout recomposition lag
- Optimized in-chat Watch Together dock layout bounds and invite glow drawing
